description.value: Macchiato Caffe is a locally owned Italian-inspired café that has been a downtown Victoria fixture for nearly two decades, operating at the Johnson Street address as 'Macchiato @ The Juliet'. The café serves artisan espresso from Caffe Umbria — a third-generation family roaster based in Vancouver — alongside freshly made panini, salads, soups, and baked goods prepared on-site daily. Both downtown locations offer comfortable indoor seating and an outdoor patio, making them a natural mid-ride stop in the heart of Victoria's Old Town.
